name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 1 No 115

clue.text: Here with members in order to salute

Bodice has bulge in the middle
David, for example, has short time to wait
Hand exposed as fool
Public declaration of policy to see off famines first
Clean hands, like Chesterton’s father had

Low murmuring, funny, out of key and monotonous
Start of instructions to look elsewhere in works for leak
Feeling of weariness that may come from pollen nuisance
Credit employers, taking notice of campaigners
A possible criminal, whichever way you look at it
Author less prolific than Ibsen?
Blind man acceptable for Bench
Anxious to give up half-hearted West Indian music
Sect, say, destroyed in religious frenzy
Skilled craftsman and master builder
Walks unsteadily in winds
Woman from North Africa — or Western part
Gracious act from boyfriend over recital of joke

Fly over middle of the Cape? That’s ungentlemanly behaviour

Sort of irons used in Scottish game
Free display out of doors
Chap’s excessive pride in waterproof house
One who is acting in rep
King is brought up to be master
